conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful system, Polyquaternium-10 (10), plus light routes: Glycosphingolipids (5), Hydrolyzed Silk (6), Sericin (7), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (9), Glyceryl Oleate (15), Glycol Distearate (17), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (18), Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil (21). C2 not met (no silicone, no prominent payload lipid, no deliberate humectant).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PQ-10 and lipids are post-fragrance; low realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: many light families, but the only cationic is a post-fragrance Polyquaternium-10, the lipids are late/trace, and proteins are water-soluble; effective C1 reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: PQ-10 (10), proteins (6, 7), weak refatters (5, 9, 15), late lipids (18, 21).

persistence.rationale: No silicone; HCO and apricot oil trace after PEG-40 HCO; proteins rinse.

unresolved: lipid-like additive; read as weak_refatter (cf. Lecithin); level likely low despite position
weightPotential.counterSignal: Four deposition families including PQ-10 and a waxy lipid; combined residue could be noticeable.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Every depositing family is light, late or water-soluble; reset is effective.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the cationic family is a single PQ-10 after Parfum (10); proteins (6, 7) are water-soluble hydrolysates at marketing level (before Parfum but after Glycosphingolipids); the lipids are trace (HCO 18 and apricot oil 21, after PEG-40 HCO and the pearlizer); an effective SLES reset faces only light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Four light families; combined effect uncertain, moderate realistic.

Formula has a plausible smoothing/light-film route: Hydrolyzed Silk (6), Sericin (7), Glycosphingolipids (5, the claimed 'Ceramide'), Polyquaternium-10 (10).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Repair wording ('schützt und stärkt das Haar', 'sprödes Haar') and a repair_supported frozen verdict.
